name: ATM serine/threonine kinase

function.text: ATM encodes a protein kinase that coordinates DNA-damage responses, particularly following DNA double-strand breaks, through checkpoint and repair signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to ATM-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); ataxia telangiectasia (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mantle cell lymphoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma; T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: ATM encodes a protein kinase that coordinates DNA-damage responses, particularly following DNA double-strand breaks, through checkpoint and repair signaling.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with ATM-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); ataxia telangiectasia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ATM have been reported in mantle cell lymphoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and t-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.
